Why Choose Bagalur for Your Dream Home?

  • Proximity to IT Hubs: Close to Manyata Tech Park, KIADB Aerospace Park, and Bangalore International Airport, making it an ideal residential choice for professionals.

  • Educational Institutions: Reputed schools and colleges such as Delhi Public School, Reva University, and Presidency College are within easy reach.

  • Healthcare Facilities: Top hospitals like Columbia Asia, Aster CMI, and Cloudnine provide world-class medical care.

  • Entertainment & Shopping: Residents can enjoy a vibrant social life with malls like Elements Mall, Orion East Mall, and RMZ Galleria nearby.
